about_the_game:
The main character is a card user.

defeats monsters and strengthens his cards

and aim for the depths of the labyrinth.

Even if he is defeated by a monster and dies

the hero has the ability to repeat the loop

the power of the strengthened card is inherited,

challenge the labyrinth again and again.

In the fantasy world built by roguelike x card game x loop scenario,

Create your own deck and reach the deepest part of the dragon labyrinth.

■Story

Thanks to the efforts of the Time Traveler, who repeatedly loops through time,

the abnormal situation where two Gates of Time opened simultaneously

was successfully resolved.

However, this peace did not last long.

Those who covet the Gates of Time, which connect to another world,

were beginning to stir.

Incidents of explorers being attacked by demonic insects began occurring one after another.

To investigate the cause, I joined the expedition team.

Through repeating the loop, the Time Traveler, having noticed the intricate traps set by those lurking in the darkness,

once again ventured deeper into the Dragon Labyrinth where the Gates of Time lay.

■Differences from Previous Work

・Card types, events, and other content have been expanded from the previous title.

◆New Feature: [Battles Against Multiple Monsters] added

◆New Feature: [New Cards with Area-of-Effect Attacks and More] added

◆New Feature: [Magic Items Usable at Any Time] added

With the implementation of battles against multiple monsters,

more challenging fights than previous titles are expected.

However, the addition of cards specifically designed to handle multiple monsters

introduces new strategic options.

Even players who have played the previous title can enjoy fresh dungeon exploration.

content_descriptors.notes: Because of the theme of Death Loop, there is bloodshed and violence on the level of a juvenile magazine.
